funnel.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions, sessions_with_cart_additions, sessions_that_reached_checkout, sessions_that_completed_checkout SINCE 2026-10-19 UNTIL 2026-11-17

referrer.query: FROM sales SHOW orders, gross_sales GROUP BY order_referrer_source SINCE 2026-10-19 UNTIL 2026-11-17
